comment appends comments/<date>-<author>-<nn>.md to an issue's folder.

Comments are append-only, one file each. The two-digit sequence is not
decoration: without it a second comment by the same author on the same day
silently overwrites the first, and this picks the next one by looking at what is
already there.

The issue's own README is never touched. With no -m, your $EDITOR is opened on
an empty file and an empty file means nothing was written.

Usage:
  isu comment <id> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help             help for comment
  -m, --message string   the comment (default: open $EDITOR)

Global Flags:
      --fetch         update remote refs before reading
      --json          print newline-delimited JSON instead of text
      --no-color      never colour the output
      --ref string    the ref isu treats as trunk (default: main, else master, else HEAD)
      --repo string   the repository to read (default: the working directory)
